name: web-search-tools
description: External web-SEARCH consumer: exposes the `web-search@1` capability as the tools 'web search' (normalized results + caps/spill) and 'web search providers' (configured/available engines + the config row to add) - provider agnostic, no engine named

config.description: The consumer only shapes the tools it registers; the engine selection, the count caps and the spill behaviour belong to the providers' rows (web-search-impl, web-search-stub, web-search-tavily).
